# codebase-agent-os-demo-pages

Static/demo pages for the agent-OS demo. Mostly visual reference.

## Stack & contents

Vanilla JS / HTML, ~40 flat files. Multi-page demo (app.js, app3-app7.js, command/config/feed-detail pages) plus three QA-ROUND reports and an `UPGRADE-PLAN.md`.

## Why this is here

Earlier multi-page sibling of `codebase-agent-os-demo`. The `UPGRADE-PLAN.md` records the path that eventually led to v8.

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/codebase-agent-os-demo-pages:code/agent-os-demo-pages/UPGRADE-PLAN.md
```
